nodes.label: Block content model
nodes.summary: Page and reusable block content are typed JSON block trees validated against the block registry.

nodes.label: Page content editor invariants
nodes.summary: Page editor clones content before mutation, allows reusable references only at top level, and rejects top-level inline page blocks.

nodes.label: Reusable block editor invariants
nodes.summary: Reusable block editor mutates cloned block trees and only edits nested block fields within one reusable block root.

nodes.label: Parent-based page paths
nodes.summary: Page paths are derived from parent links plus normalized path segments, with root pages pinned to '/'.

nodes.label: Draft/publish state
nodes.summary: Page and reusable block publish state prefers explicit boolean flags, falling back to draft and published version id comparison.

nodes.label: Supabase session validation
nodes.summary: Server hook creates Supabase client from public env and validates sessions by confirming authenticated user.

nodes.label: Page SEO metadata
nodes.summary: SEO metadata lives under meta.seo, parses unknown input to trimmed strings and booleans, and serializes empty strings as null.

edges.evidence: BLOCK_REGISTRY declares text, hero, and section block definitions plus field types and allowed nested block types.
isValidBlockInstance loads a block definition by type before validating fields.
areValidBlockFields rejects unknown field keys and validates every known field against the registry definition.
normalizeBlockInstance filters optional empty or invalid fields while preserving valid field values.
createDefaultBlockInstance uses registry field definitions to initialize string, boolean, and blocks fields.
isPageContent validates blocks through isPageBlockNode, which accepts reusable references or valid block instances.
ReusableBlockReference stores reusableBlockId and is later constrained by page editor validation.
parsePageContent returns EMPTY_PAGE_CONTENT when unknown input is not valid PageContent.
serializePageContent throws 'Invalid page content' unless value passes isPageContent.
createEditablePageContent returns cloned blocks or a fresh empty content object before editor helpers mutate state.
addBlockAtPath pushes createDefaultBlockInstance output into the resolved block list.
addReusableBlockReference appends a type 'reusable' node directly to content.blocks.
insertReusableBlockReferenceAtIndex rejects indexes outside 0..blocks.length before splicing into content.blocks.
Validation rejects nested reusable references, missing referenced ids, and top-level inline page blocks.
validateFieldValue switches on field.type and required to produce editor errors.
createEditableReusableBlockContent returns cloneBlock(content) before reusable block editor helpers mutate fields or lists.
parseSubmittedReusableBlockContent JSON parses and returns value only when isValidBlockInstance passes.
Validation walks the reusable block root and nested block fields, rejecting unknown block types and disallowed nested types.
addNestedReusableBlockAtPath resolves a nested blocks field and pushes a default block instance.
isReusableBlockDraft rejects drafts unless content is a valid block instance and content.type equals block_type.
PageDraftVersion has content: PageContent and meta: Record<string, unknown>.
ReusableBlock has content: BlockInstance.
validatePagePathInput enforces title, root behavior, slash rejection, and normalized path segment rules.
buildPagePathMap recursively resolves parent paths, throws on missing nodes or cycles, and joins segments.
buildPagePathPreview validates proposed inputs, overlays the edited page into pages, then reads preview path from buildPagePathMap.
getPagePublishState returns unpublished, draft-changes, or published from pageIsPublished and pageHasDraftChanges.
getReusableBlockPublishState mirrors page publish classification for reusable blocks.
Both helpers prefer has_unpublished_changes when present, otherwise compare draft and published version ids.
parsePageSeoMeta returns empty defaults unless meta.seo is an object, then trims strings and reads boolean flags.
serializePageSeoMeta preserves object meta fields and writes seo with empty strings converted to null.
handle creates event.locals.supabase and safeGetSession for each request.
getSupabasePublicEnv throws when PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY is missing.
App.Locals declares supabase and safeGetSession so route code can use the authenticated request context.
Specs cover cloning, nested insert/update/remove, top-level reusable references, missing references, and inline top-level rejection.
Specs assert valid primitive and nested block parsing plus rejection for unknown fields, invalid dates, and disallowed nested block types.
Specs show root '/', child '/about', and grandchild '/about/team' paths from explicit parent links.

edges.context: Sidebar.svelte derives pageTree from currentPages using buildSidebarTree, so page navigation renders from hierarchical page data rather than flat page arrays.
Sidebar.svelte derives reusableBlocksTree from folders and reusableBlocks so content library navigation mirrors folder/block hierarchy.
collectAncestorPageIds walks SidebarTreeNode roots and returns the active page path, which Sidebar.svelte uses to reopen closed ancestors.
collectReusableBlockFolderAncestors returns parent folder ids for a selected reusable block folder so Sidebar.svelte can reopen its tree path.
An effect in Sidebar.svelte iterates collectAncestorPageIds(pageTree, activePageId) and clears closedNodes for each ancestor id.
Sidebar.svelte derives active reusable block folder id then reopens folder ancestors returned by collectReusableBlockFolderAncestors.
Expanded content iterates pageTree roots and delegates each node to SidebarPageTreeItem, which renders nested pages and publish state dots.
Expanded content iterates reusableBlocksTree folders and delegates folder rows to SidebarReusableBlocksTreeItem.
Expanded content renders root-level reusableBlocksTree.blocks with SidebarReusableBlockRow.
SidebarReusableBlocksTreeItem recursively renders child folders and renders each folder's blocks with SidebarReusableBlockRow.
Collapsed rail defines each rail item with a SidebarDesktopFocus value and calls onDesktopRailSelect for non-route focus items.
Sidebar.svelte watches desktopFocus, opens target folders when needed, then scrolls page/content sections into view.
runSidebarAction posts an intent payload, applies returned pages/blockFolders/reusableBlocks/reference maps, then shows a success or error notice.
Sidebar delete page modal sends intent deletePage, blocks child-page deletion in UI, and redirects away from deleted editor route.
Sidebar delete folder modal tells user folder deletion only succeeds when no child folders or content items exist.
Sidebar delete content modal lists pages referencing the block and warns references will be removed from published and draft pages.
SidebarReusableBlockRow enables dragging when insertion is allowed and calls setReusableBlockDragData with the block id on dragstart.
ReusableBlockInsertion serializes reusableBlockId for drag data and uses the same reusableBlockId shape for insert requests.
insertBlockIntoCurrentPage calls requestReusableBlockInsert and reports success only when a page editor handler is registered.
SidebarPageTreeItem calls getPagePublishState and maps draft-changes/published/unpublished to status labels and dots.
SidebarReusableBlockRow calls getReusableBlockPublishState and maps draft-changes/published/unpublished to row status dots.
ToastProvider calls setToastState once and renders children with ToastViewport bound to the created state.
ToastViewport reads toastState.toasts, renders each toast, computes progress from createdAt/durationMs, and removes toast on action or dismiss.
ToastState stores timeout handles per toast; ToastViewport separately ticks current time for progress display while state removes expired toasts.
requireAuthenticatedUser redirects unauthenticated page requests to buildAuthRedirectPath while API requests throw 401.
auth.spec.ts verifies root redirects to /auth and nested/query paths preserve redirectTo.
parsePage computes both draft path and live_path from separate draft/published path maps built from version parent/segment fields.
Parsed Page objects include path and parent_page_id, which sidebar tree code uses for hierarchy and expanded content displays as page paths.
getPages excludes deleted pages by default, so soft-deleted pages disappear from normal sidebar page lists.
softDeletePageById loads page metadata and throws when parent_page_id is null, preventing the root page from being moved to trash.
Reference lookup loops through each page draft_version_id and published_version_id to detect reusable block references across both states.
removeReusableBlockReferencesFromPages first calls getPagesReferencingReusableBlock, then updates matching page versions.
Reference cleanup updates draft and published version content through updateDraftVersionContent after filtering reference blocks.
parseReusableBlock resolves draft/published version content and calls parseReusableBlockContent, which normalizes and validates block instances.
parseReusableBlock emits folder_id from the selected draft or published version, which reusable block tree construction groups under folders.
deleteBlockFolder rejects folders with child folders or non-deleted reusable blocks before deleting the folder row.
Reusable blocks and pages both archive old versions, create published snapshots, create or keep drafts, and compute unpublished-change flags by comparing draft and published data.
Sidebar.svelte accepts reusableBlockPageReferences from sidebar action responses and stores them for delete content modals.
